The '''blue-breasted hover ibbot''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[ibbot]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. The [[Bird/Legends|bird]], one of sixty-eight varieties of ibbots found on the planet, had a wingspan of seven [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] and evolved to hold a particular niche in Drall's ecosystem.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blue-breasted hover ibbot was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
